Over the past decade, this partnership has helped create meaningful opportunities and shared success across northern Saskatchewan. Looking back on all that's been accomplished reminds us of the power of strong relationships, collaboration and a shared vision for the future. This transportation has a planned highway 914 North road closure - Pinehouse Junction to Key Lake mine - from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on the 8th. We also want to shout out fellow finalists Miyosiwin Salon Spa , Optek Solutions and Tangles Hair & Beauty Salon along with the rest of this year's nominees and award recipients. More than 400 Cameco employees and family members took part as runners and volunteers last weekend, and our own senior vice-presidents Lisa Aitken and Rachelle Girard were honoured to hand out medals at the finish line.
